title: Project repository
summary: Account-owned and product-scoped descriptors, revision fencing and trusted document mutations. This is integrity machinery, not a creator-editable data protocol.

carrier.notes: Gate execution_id is execution_ plus the first 32 hex characters of SHA-256 over canonical product/account/session/root-turn/turn/capability/resource-scope data. Scope includes project_revision and authorization context. A proven-not-started step terminalizes RELEASED; the identical request replays its failed outcome, rather than running again.

replaceability.why: Holds Project integrity or trusted execution authority; replacing it requires Lumeri control.

reach.notes: Trusted Runtime seam, not an additional grant to a creator Luc.

operations.name: create
operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam. Create revision zero. Single descriptor replacement; no client_op_id receipt transaction. A repeated explicit id is rejected; an omitted id creates a new Project.

operations.name: get
operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam. Wrong-account lookup is indistinguishable from absence; Python exceptions have no additional module-specific code here.

operations.name: list
operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam.

operations.name: require_revision
operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam. Mismatch raises ValueError; the HTTP caller maps a revision conflict to 409.

operations.name: advance_revision
operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam. One atomic descriptor replacement increments revision and records intent. Retrying the old expected revision fails; this primitive does not deduplicate mutation_id.

operations.name: apply_document_mutation

mutate.description: Trusted Python callable(document) -> dict; not serializable JSON.

operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam. The current broker serializes a document edit with its revision under a mutation lease, but writes document.json and project.json separately. It has no single crash-atomic client_op_id result-record commit. It is not yet eligible for replaceable writes under the self-Luc run gate. Only the latest last_revision_intent_id is deduplicated by this primitive. Schema projects a Python callable as a descriptor, not a wire format.

operations.name: read_document
operations.notes: No operation deadline is enforced at this seam. Descriptor and document are read sequentially; this is not a single consistent snapshot across concurrent writers.

invariants.text: A lookup never returns another account or product's Project.
A fresh document mutation requires the exact expected revision and increments it by one.
For governed calls, a definitive no-side-effect failure is RELEASED and the identical execution identity replays that failure. A new attempt must not be disguised as a retry.

break: An unhandled exception, invalid output, or failed declared artifact check.
failure.notes: The original reports failure today. The self-Luc run gate and original fallback are requirements for a future replacement, not a promise this seam already implements.

conformance.notes: Contract schema checking is available; replacement conformance is not wired at this seam.

known_deviations.text: The current broker serializes a document edit with its revision under a mutation lease, but writes document.json and project.json separately. It has no single crash-atomic client_op_id result-record commit. It is not yet eligible for replaceable writes under the self-Luc run gate.
read_document releases the descriptor read before reading the product document; the mutation lease does not make these two reads a transaction.
The execution journal stores immutable effect results separately from Project persistence. It does not make the Project document, revision and client_op_id result record one atomic commit.
